pages.title: Perfusion Rig
pages.text: A pump and a web of fine tubing that pushes warm nutrient through a scaffold of tissue, keeping every cell fed.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the pump pressure and the vessel radius. The flow is Poiseuille's Q = pi.r^4.dP / 8.eta.L, and must reach the recipe's rate; narrow vessels need much more pressure (the fourth power of the radius). Over a wall shear of 10 Pa the vessel tears.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Perfused Tissue, Stem Cell Culture.
